title: Stuck in Fastboot mode
fullDescription: OnePlus phones can get stuck on the Fastboot Mode screen with options for Start, Recovery, Restart bootloader, Power off. Often happens after a botched update or accidental key combo.

fixSteps.title: Select Start
fixSteps.instruction: Use volume keys to highlight Start, press power to confirm.

fixSteps.title: Force reboot
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Power + Volume Up for 15 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Re-flash via MSM Tool
fixSteps.instruction: Use OnePlus MSM Download Tool with stock firmware.

title: OxygenOS / OTA update failed
fullDescription: OxygenOS OTA updates can fail when device has a rooted system, modified partitions, or insufficient storage. Sometimes Google Play Services causes issues.

fixSteps.title: Wait and retry
fixSteps.instruction: Wait a day for server-side fixes, retry.

fixSteps.title: Sideload OTA via Recovery
fixSteps.instruction: Download full OTA zip, sideload via adb sideload in Recovery.

title: Vertical green line on AMOLED
fullDescription: OnePlus 8/8T/9 series suffer from notorious green line issue where a vertical green or pink line appears on the AMOLED display, usually after software updates. OnePlus has offered free repairs for affected units.

fixSteps.title: Contact OnePlus support
fixSteps.instruction: OnePlus has a free repair program for known affected models.

fixSteps.title: Display replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Out of program: AMOLED panel replacement.

faq.a: OnePlus offers it for affected serials.

title: Touchscreen unresponsive
fullDescription: OnePlus touchscreens can stop responding entirely or in dead zones. Causes range from screen protector interference to digitizer failure to software glitches.

fixSteps.title: Force reboot
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Power + Volume Up for 15 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Remove screen protector
fixSteps.instruction: Test without protector to rule it out.

fixSteps.title: Display replacement
fixSteps.instruction: If touch still dead, AMOLED+digitizer replacement needed.

faq.a: Most modern Androids don't allow this.

title: Fast charging not working
fullDescription: OnePlus's proprietary charging (Dash, Warp, SuperVOOC, 100W+) requires the original charger AND original cable. Generic USB-C PD chargers fall back to slow 5V/2A.

fixSteps.title: Use OnePlus charger + cable
fixSteps.instruction: Use the bundled SuperVOOC/Warp charger and cable. The cable has special pins.

fixSteps.title: Replace USB-C port
fixSteps.instruction: If pins are bent, replace USB-C flex.

videoSearchQuery: OnePlus Warp charge not working fix

faq.a: Will work but slow — proprietary needed for fast.

title: OnePlus bootloop
fullDescription: OnePlus phones can bootloop after failed root, custom ROM, or update. Recovery and MSM Tool are the main remediation paths.

fixSteps.title: Recovery wipe cache
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Volume Down + Power, choose Recovery, wipe cache.

fixSteps.title: MSM Download Tool flash
fixSteps.instruction: Use OnePlus MSM Tool with matching firmware to flash everything to stock.

faq.a: Most older models yes; newer use OnePlus Toolbox.

title: Camera not working
fullDescription: OnePlus camera service crashes after updates or with conflicting third-party camera apps (Google Camera ports). Cache clearing usually resolves.

fixSteps.title: Clear camera cache
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Apps > Camera > Storage > Clear cache.

faq.a: Yes if compatible; uninstall to test stock first.

title: Alert slider stuck or not responding
fullDescription: OnePlus's signature Alert Slider can fail mechanically or stop being detected by software. It's a Hall-effect or magnetic switch — clean it or replace the assembly.

fixSteps.title: Clean around slider
fixSteps.instruction: Use compressed air around the slider track to clear debris.

fixSteps.title: Reboot
fixSteps.instruction: Some software glitches resolve with reboot.

fixSteps.title: Replace slider assembly
fixSteps.instruction: Open back, replace slider switch flex.

videoSearchQuery: OnePlus alert slider not working fix

faq.a: OnePlus 12R and some newer models removed it.
